parameters.name: DatabaseAddress
parameters.description: The address of the database that you want to query. Only term query is supported.

parameters.name: DatabaseName
parameters.description: The name of the database instance that you want to query.

parameters.name: DatabaseType
parameters.description:
The type of the database that you want to query. Valid values:

- **MySQL**

- **Oracle**

- **PostgreSQL**

- **SQLServer**

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: NetworkDomainId
parameters.description: The ID of the network domain.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the paged query. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. By default, 20 entries are returned on each page. If you leave the PageSize parameter empty, 20 entries are returned. > We recommend that you do not leave the PageSize parameter empty.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: UserGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the user group for which you want to query authorized databases.
